name: pub style lentils
instructions:
PUB STYLE LENTILS — the Jamie Oliver pub version. Core recipe: his Allotment Cottage Pie. REWRITTEN 2026-11-20 from the merged two-build file; the ale + pickle line is split out to [[pickle-lentil-relish]], and [[shittake-lentil-soup]] is the clean soup sibling.

=== THE BUILD ===

- BROWN LENTILS — you want brown lentils here, not french lentils or black lentils.
- CREMINI and PORTABELLA MUSHROOMS (both primary; cremini preferred) + ONIONS + GARLIC, sautéed in BUTTER. No olive oil (clashing). Mushroom texture flexible — diced, whole, or pureed all fine; the chunk is nice here.
- GLUTAMATES: TOMATO PASTE + MARMITE + WORCESTERSHIRE + PORCINI POWDER. MARMITE CAN BE SWAPPED FOR DARK VEGETABLE BROTH — but you don't want all three of tomato paste / marmite / vegetable broth, because it gets TOO GUMMY.
- THE FLAVOR ENGINE: LEMON + CUMIN + ROSEMARY — they go together because they balance each other (lemon balances the rosemary and the marmite; cumin balances the lemon; use a relatively generous amount of lemon juice). FENNEL POWDER works instead of cumin. THYME good too; BAY LEAF is the rosemary substitute. Cumin as SEEDS, never ground powder on top.
- BARLEY — works here as a primary ingredient (2026-11-20).
- SALT + BLACK PEPPER.

=== SERVING ===

You can put potatoes in it if you want, but I think it's served best as a RELISH ON TOP OF BAKED POTATOES with SOUR CREAM or GREEK YOGURT.

PIE FORMAT (optional, the cottage lineage): transfer to a baking dish, top with mashed potatoes, bake ~20 min at 375°F, then scatter MONTERREY JACK and bake ~10-15 more until golden.
notes:
=== REWRITTEN (2026-11-20) ===

Rewritten from the merged two-build file (merged 2026-11-02 from lentil cottage pie + mushroom pickle relish). The ale + pickle build is now its own recipe, [[pickle-lentil-relish]]. The old layered notes (smoke-source revision stages, the reference log, the anglo spice cabinet) are recoverable from git.

=== THE SMOKE — AND THE CONTRAST WITH THE CLEAN SOUP ===

All of the CREMINI MUSHROOMS, BUTTER, and SPICES contribute to a smoky flavor profile — the contrast with the clean soup version of this recipe, [[shittake-lentil-soup]] (the shittake / fresh tomato soup: no butter, no porcini powder, no spices).

=== THE ANCHOR SWAP — AND THE GUMMY RULE ===

MARMITE can be swapped for DARK VEGETABLE BROTH. But you don't want all three of TOMATO PASTE / MARMITE / VEGETABLE BROTH — it gets TOO GUMMY. (Restates the old never-stack-anchors rule.) PORCINI POWDER adds glutamates without tipping the scales — cited by [[bolognese]] and [[french-beef-and-mushroom-stew]].

=== THE FLAVOR ENGINE: LEMON + CUMIN + ROSEMARY ===

Lemon, cumin, and rosemary go together because they balance each other. FENNEL POWDER works instead of cumin. Sensitive to too much flavor injector of any kind — rosemary, marmite, lemon all overshoot easily. If rosemary is unavailable, bay leaf is the most appropriate substitute; thyme is good but rosemary is more critical. CUMIN SEEDS ONLY, never ground cumin powder on top (over-spices; cumin powder clashing).

=== LENTIL CHOICE ===

BROWN LENTILS — not french (le puy) or black lentils.

=== BARLEY (2026-11-20) ===

Barley works in here as a primary ingredient.

=== CARAWAY — CLASHING HERE, EVEN THOUGH IT WORKS IN THE PICKLE VERSION ===

Caraway is clashing in this recipe even though it works in [[pickle-lentil-relish]]: it tasted OK in the pot, but overnight it just turned horrible — judge a stew by its leftover state, not its day-one state.

=== REVERSALS (2026-11-20) ===

- PORTABELLA: promoted back to primary alongside cremini (was demoted to secondary 2026-11-17; cremini still preferred).
- CARROTS and DIJON MUSTARD stay out — I don't want them in the jamie version, it doesn't seem appropriate (more of a [[french-lentils]] thing). Clashing.

=== ROOTS ===

Celery root and rutabaga secondary (they're in the Jamie Oliver — his Allotment scaffold runs on swede + celeriac). Root vegetables like spice; roots are the best vegetarian meat substitute at chunky cut (cited by [[braised-turnips]]).

=== SIBLING RECIPES ===

- [[pickle-lentil-relish]]: the ale + pickle line, split out 2026-11-20 — pairs with pork and hot-dog-like things, where this one pairs with potatoes.
- [[shittake-lentil-soup]]: the clean soup sibling — shittakes, fresh tomato, no butter/spices.
- [[french-lentils]]: the french-kit cousin (wine/cream/mustard register).
- [[braised-turnips]]: natural side; shares the turnip register.
